title: Simple Shopping
subtitle: Buying clothes at a small store — for English learners

sentences.en: Hi, can I help you find anything today?
sentences.target: Hi, can I help you find anything today?

sentences.en: Yes, I'm looking for a blue shirt in size medium.
sentences.target: Yes, I'm looking for a blue shirt in size medium.

sentences.en: We have a few options over here on this rack.
sentences.target: We have a few options over here on this rack.

sentences.en: How much does this one cost?
sentences.target: How much does this one cost?

sentences.en: It's twenty-five dollars, but it's on sale for twenty.
sentences.target: It's twenty-five dollars, but it's on sale for twenty.

sentences.en: Can I try it on before I buy it?
sentences.target: Can I try it on before I buy it?

sentences.en: Of course. The fitting rooms are at the back.
sentences.target: Of course. The fitting rooms are at the back.

sentences.en: It fits well. I'll take this one, please.
sentences.target: It fits well. I'll take this one, please.

sentences.en: Will that be cash or card?
sentences.target: Will that be cash or card?

sentences.en: I'll pay with a card. Thank you for your help.
